paragraphs: SUCCESSOR Ω — 1.24.1. Build and examine a bounded mission capability, retain useful knowledge and require every successor to earn new proof and permission. Bilingual mission workspace · Quickstart and operator guide · Architecture and boundaries · Release notes and acceptance requirements. Local rehearsal is not independent qualification or production authority. Existing missions, research and flowcharts remain available.

Choose a current launch path: browser mission, minimal native installation, operator recovery and upgrades, or Hardhat deployment and migration guide. The repository guide explains which dependencies each path needs. Publication requires the exact-commit acceptance workflow; use the matching published release assets and manifest.

Current contract configuration: Solidity reference contracts pin the canonical $AGIALPHA address 0xa61a3b3a130a9c20768eebf97e21515a6046a1fa and 18 decimals. Environment variables do not override those Solidity constants. The historical alternate-network override instruction retained below is superseded by the current contract guide. Its local fixture is disposable and does not deploy to an external chain, migrate real tokens or establish production authority.
